Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation (FPVS) combines periodic visual stimulation
with frequency-domain analysis of brain activity. This guide is a growing,
practical introduction to the method, from its core concepts through paradigm
design and data analysis.

## Start with the foundations

[What Is FPVS?](what-is-fpvs.qmd) introduces the method and the questions this
guide will address. [Frequency Tagging](frequency-tagging.qmd) explains the
central relationship between stimulation frequencies and measured neural
responses.

## Design an FPVS experiment

[Experiment Design](paradigm-design.qmd) introduces dedicated pages covering
frequency choices, stimulus selection and sequencing, display timing,
participant attention, and common paradigm patterns.

## Understand the analysis

[Analysis Workflow](analysis-workflow.qmd) outlines the stages that will be
covered from raw EEG data through response quantification and quality control.

## Look up terms and sources

[Glossary and References](glossary-references.qmd) will collect definitions,
recommended reading, and sources cited throughout the guide.

::: {.callout-note}
## Guide in development
